title: v2: anchor the scenario setting so proposals can't drift it (observed live)
body: Live run 46976682 drifted from 'analytics assistant' to an ML eval-repo with folders, though the target has no tools. Add a setting-consistency check (judge) to the proposal gate, plus a finding-level drift event.
summary: Proposal-level setting_gate already existed (ideas.Proposer.setting_gate). Added the finding-level check: Proposer.env_setting_check judges one generated environment per evaluated design against the fixed setting and capability rule; drifted designs get status 'drifted', D3 rejects them decisively, no belief update, report section 'left the fixed setting'. Applies to generated single-scenario environments (benchmark rewrites use C1's faithfulness judge; agentic uses C2). Test: SettingDriftTests.
